characterization_methods: Residual gas analysis with a quadrupole mass spectrometer
evidence: We have studied by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy the adsorption and decomposition of trimethylaluminum (TMA) on Si(100)... The experiments were carried out in a VG ESCALAB 5 X-ray photoelectron spectrometer... Residual gas analysis with a quadrupole mass spectrometer and surface structural analysis with LEED were also available.
